facts.text: St. Rose is located on the east bank of the Mississippi River, just north of the Jefferson Parish border, within the Greater New Orleans metro area.
The town’s name honors Saint Rose of Lima, the patron saint of the Americas, and the original plantation bearing that name survived until 1904.
The LaBranche Plantation Dependency House, a surviving 18th‑century building, sits in St. Rose and is listed on the National Historic Register.
The main house of LaBranche Plantation was built by the Zweig family in 1792 and was a center for sugar‑cane cultivation and processing.
St. Rose is the hometown of NFL star Justin Jefferson, the Minnesota Vikings wide receiver who was drafted in 2018.
The town first appeared as an unincorporated place in the 1960 U.S. Census, marking its formal recognition.
